init_hook: echo 'orbit env ready. usage: devbox run <init|fmt|validate|plan|apply|destroy> [-- <root>]. root defaults to infra-ecs.'

scripts.ecr-login: aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin $(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text).dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
